161:     """Calculate DPI from OOXML `word/document.xml` page size (w:pgSz in twips).
162: 
163:     DOCX stores page dimensions in section properties as twips (1/1440 inch).
164:     We read the first encountered section's page size and compute an isotropic DPI
165:     that fits within the target max pixel dimensions.
166:     """

168:     with ZipFile(input_path, "r") as zf:
169:         xml = _read_ooxml_member(zf, "word/document.xml")
170:     root = ET.fromstring(xml)
171:     ns = {"w": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"}
172: 
173:     # Common placements: w:body/w:sectPr or w:body/w:p/w:pPr/w:sectPr
174:     sect_pr = root.find(".//w:sectPr", ns)
175:     if sect_pr is None:
176:         raise RuntimeError("Section properties not found in document.xml")
177:     pg_sz = sect_pr.find("w:pgSz", ns)
178:     if pg_sz is None:
179:         raise RuntimeError("Page size not found in section properties")
180: 
181:     # Values are in twips
182:     w_twips_str = pg_sz.get(
183:         "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}w"
184:     ) or pg_sz.get("w")
185:     h_twips_str = pg_sz.get(
186:         "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}h"
187:     ) or pg_sz.get("h")

189:     if not w_twips_str or not h_twips_str:
190:         raise RuntimeError("Page size attributes missing in pgSz")
191: 
192:     width_in = int(w_twips_str) / TWIPS_PER_INCH
193:     height_in = int(h_twips_str) / TWIPS_PER_INCH
194:     if width_in <= 0 or height_in <= 0:
195:         raise RuntimeError("Invalid page size values in document.xml")
196:     # Best-effort warning for multi-section docs.
197:     try:
198:         dims = set()
199:         for s in root.findall(".//w:sectPr", ns):
200:             ps = s.find("w:pgSz", ns)
201:             if ps is None:
202:                 continue
203:             wv = ps.get(f"{{{ns['w']}}}w") or ps.get("w")
204:             hv = ps.get(f"{{{ns['w']}}}h") or ps.get("h")
